confidence_notes: Restaurant meal anchors are medium confidence. They come from Bolivia-wide cost-of-living sites and Uyuni tourist food guides with mixed dates and quality. Beer and coffee are medium-low, since sources disagree on local beer prices. Cocktail and wine_glass are low confidence: I found no reliable Uyuni drink prices, so they are derived from the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 2x beer). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the Uyuni context; I did not check live booking pages or current listings. FX: the 0.6955 figure for 2026-10-15 was reported in a search summary of the RBA exchange rates overview page. I could not confirm it against the RBA's F11 table. It is consistent with an OFX-derived inverse of about 0.6956, but OFX is not an RBA source. The 16 October observation was not confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. Food anchors are based on Uyuni-specific guide prices (market lunch, basic restaurant and tourist restaurant ranges) and Bolivia-wide drink and meal prices, with La Paz used only as a loose reference for restaurant levels. Drinks are scaled from the beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic estimate for a small salt-flats gateway town with tour-driven demand.
